★ Request
Show Victoire Pisa (Summer Uniform)

As I was walking toward the trainer's office,
I spotted Victoire Pisa and a student who seemed to be her friend.

Yes, you are always... taking me by the hand,
as if inviting me into the center of the circle...—
Fufu... yes, of course. I will be waiting whenever you're ready.

...I apologize. It looks like you're busy.
Should I come back later?

I'm fine.
I'm so sorry, because of me—

Trainer, I'm really okay...!
More importantly, your work data—
(I want to make you happier, more and more—)
Ah... h-how is the computer? Is your data safe...!?

(The look of pure relief on your face...
Ah, truly... Trainer, you care for me...)

Let's make sure it's firmly connected.
So that it won't come undone again.

Careless of me. Even though I knew she has a habit of wanting to connect everything,
I left the cords lying around after using them...
—Oh, this one too!

...Oh my... the plug is halfway out...
This could be dangerous...

...No.
It's nothing at all—

It was because I wanted to be of help to her
that I became her Trainer...

After checking over and over again...
It seemed she truly wasn't hurt.

Understood.
Please take your time, don't rush.

Oh... is that what happened?
A falling out with your roommate...

Yes, of course. ...Oh, why don't we go to the cafe in front of the station?
Their famous towering fruit parfait... to tell you the truth, I've always wanted to try it.

...I am so sorry. For causing something like this...
and making you worry...

Pisaaa...! You're seriously the sweetest.
I just can't help leaning on you...!

Man, I'm completely at my wit's end!
Pisa, will you join me for some stress-eating!?

We can take our time there... and you can tell me all about it.
Let's look for a solution together.
Trainer—...

Ugh, that's just it~... I want to make up with her,
but even when I talk to her, she totally ignores me...!
Kyaa...!?

I inspect every inch of her hands.
Looking for any scratches or burns—

The monitor blacks out. The wiring short-circuited!
I rush over to her side at once.

Victoire Pisa will likely stay by her friend's side until her spirits lift.
—A sight I've grown quite accustomed to.

...So warm. Your feelings, your gaze,
always, no matter when, gently envelop me...

(...Say, Trainer.
I want to get to know you even better...)

Afterward, as I was in the trainer's office facing the computer,
powering through the mountain of accumulated work—
...There, that should do it.
Trainer, I'd like to discuss tomorrow's training—
